notes.note: Self pop-flash over A main before the swing blinds both site anchors.
notes.fix: Keep it. Practise the same lineup from the other side so you're not predictable.

notes.note: Crosshair already at head height on default as you clear it, instant one-tap.
notes.fix: Nothing to change. This is pro-level pre-aim.

notes.note: Clean counter-strafe on the jiggle peek, but you re-peeked the same angle a second time.
notes.fix: After getting info on a jiggle, change angle or timing before swinging again.

notes.note: In the 1v3 you play for time on the bomb and isolate each duel instead of forcing.
notes.fix: Keep listening for the defuse tap; this clutch structure is exactly right.

prospect-great-clip.summary: Pro-level crosshair placement and clutch composure; only leak is re-peeking the same angle.

notes.note: Retaking B with no flash for the teammate swinging short.
notes.fix: Throw a flash for the entry player before calling the retake; utility first, then bodies.

notes.note: Shot fired mid-strafe out of kitchen, first bullet misses.
notes.fix: Counter-strafe: tap the opposite key to stop fully before the first shot.
Keep it consistent when moving between angles.

prospect-mirage-retake.summary: Sharp crosshair, but retakes are dry: no utility for the entry.

notes.note: Entered banana alone with the team still at the car; death is untradeable.
notes.fix: Hold until a teammate is within trade distance, or call for a flash before the swing.

notes.note: Wide-swung an angle that only needed a shoulder peek for info.
notes.fix: Shoulder peek first to bait the AWP, then decide whether to swing.

notes.note: Solid first 8 bullets of spray transfer on two players.
notes.fix: Practise spray transfers at longer range in recoil master.

drills.name: Trade-spacing deathmatch (stay within 2s of a teammate)

prospect-inferno-entry.summary: Good mechanics, but entries come before the team is ready to trade.

notes.note: AWP crosshair parked exactly where heads appear at mid.
notes.fix: Keep doing it; vary your position after each kill.

notes.note: Stayed on the same angle after the opening kill and got traded.
notes.fix: Reposition after every AWP kill: the enemy knows where you are.

notes.note: Pistol spray after the AWP went wide at mid range.
notes.fix: Burst 3 to 4 bullets at range instead of full spraying.

prospect-ancient-awp.summary: Strong AWP placement, but stays on angles too long and loses rifle/pistol fights.

notes.note: Smoke on ramp landed late, the push was already through.
notes.fix: Throw the ramp smoke on the timing call, not when you hear footsteps.

notes.note: Rotated outside alone with 3 enemies already on ramp.
notes.fix: Call info and hold the crossfire with your teammate instead of rotating solo.

notes.note: Good pre-aim through the ramp door.
notes.fix: Keep the crosshair slightly off the door frame for the wider peek.

prospect-nuke-ramp.summary: Consistent aim; utility timing and rotations need work.

notes.note: Crosshair drops below head level while clearing angles.
notes.fix: Keep the crosshair at head height while you walk; pre-aim common spots.

notes.note: Shooting while still moving after the peek.
No utility used before taking the fight.
notes.fix: Flash or smoke before entering a contested area.

_fallback.summary: Solid fundamentals; the biggest gains are in counter-strafing and using utility first.
